title: Efficient OpAmp Adaptation for Zoom Attention to Golden Contexts
authors: Haoyuan Wu; Rui Ming; Haisheng Zheng; Zhuolun He; Bei Yu
why_relevant: Proposes an attention adaptation method to mitigate distraction from noisy retrieved documents in RAG, directly targeting the problem of LLMs allocating attention to irrelevant contexts instead of the golden document.
why_not_or_caveat: Architectural method rather than retrieval-side robustness; evaluation focuses on noisy-context QA benchmarks.
